metadata.description: Green City Map: score every residential street of a city for how good it is to live on, from open data.

plugins.name: green-city-map
plugins.description: Scores every residential street of a city 0-100 for light and open views, trees, nature on foot, quiet, few tourists and daily needs without a car. Open data only (OpenStreetMap, Overture Maps, Copernicus Sentinel-2, ESA WorldCover). Runs a local Python pipeline and builds a review map.
